name: Half-Angle Slice Rendering
definition: A method for adding volumetric shadowing to particle systems by rendering particles as slices perpendicular to a half-angle vector (between view and light directions), allowing simultaneous accumulation of shadowing and blending using a single 2D shadow buffer.
summary: Half-Angle Slice Rendering computes volumetric shadows by projecting particles onto a 2D buffer using a half-angle vector, avoiding complex 3D textures.
